label: Metrics REST API (Sync Gateway)
type: the Sync Gateway REST surface (port 4986 by default) exposing statistics in either JSON or Prometheus format, gated through the same Server-RBAC-reused identity system (sgw:rbac-user) as the Admin REST API. Configured via api.metricsInterface.
note: No authentication/authorization requirement is stated on the deploy-side stats-prometheus.md page for reaching this API at all - contrast with the bare, undescribed metrics_interface_authentication setting row in command-line-options.md. Left as an open question rather than assumed either way.
